title: Position-level Greeks snapshot (greeks-snapshot/1)
description: Net greeks for ONE position, aggregated by the analytics owner (algo_scalper_api: broker values first, Black-Scholes fallback with Newton-Raphson IV solve, legacy ATM-heuristic last). Per-strike greeks already travel inside chain-snapshot/1; this contract covers the portfolio view of an open position. Status: proposed (gap G3 in docs/architecture/INFRASTRUCTURE_ROADMAP.md) - the agent currently manages risk in premium terms only.

position_id.description: Owning system's position identifier (agent correlation id or Rails position_tracker id).

strike.description: Strike for single-leg positions; null for multi-leg aggregates.

signed_quantity.description: Signed quantity in units (lot_size x lots); positive = long, negative = short.

entry_price.description: Average entry premium per unit, when known.

source.description: Where the greeks came from: broker chain values, Black-Scholes model, ATM heuristic, or a mix across legs.

theta_per_day.description: Theta per calendar day in rupees for the whole position.

vega_per_1pct.description: Vega per 1% IV move in rupees for the whole position.

rho.description: Rho per 1% rate move. The Rails BSM uses r = 0.065 (India 91-day T-bill default).
